title: Lazada Product Data Scraper
description: Search for products on Lazada and extract structured data with automatic price normalization and currency detection.

keyword.title: Search Keyword
keyword.description: Product keyword to search for on Lazada (e.g. 'smartphone', 'xiaomi', 'running shoes')

country.title: Country / Site
country.description: Select the Lazada country site to search on

maxPages.title: Max Pages to Scrape
maxPages.description: Maximum number of search result pages to scrape (each page has ~40 products)

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Lazada blocks datacenter IPs. Select **Residential** proxies for best results, or **Datacenter** for light usage.
